question: What cumulative measles death toll (confirmed + suspected) will Bangladesh's DGHS report for 12 November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Latest DGHS bulletin (24h to 08:00 1 Nov, per TBS) shows 1,254 cumulative deaths (1,149 suspected + 105 confirmed). October averaged ~4.7/day, the last week ~3.9/day and the last 3 bulletins ~1.7/day, possibly lowered by the Fri-Sat weekend. Suspected cases are still ~1,350/day, so deaths should keep accruing. A central ~3.4/day over 11 bulletins gives ~1,291. The right tail allows for a batch addition of unrecorded deaths (there is precedent). No human market found.
calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the factual base (1,254 on 1 Nov, 11 bulletins remaining) and on the history of increments. There were no factual disputes, and none could be checked without web access (the 2 Nov bulletin is unseen). The disagreement is a judgment call: how much weight to give the late-October slowdown (1.7/day over 3 bulletins, weekend-affected) against the ~4-4.7/day October average. I partly discount the slowdown as a weekend reporting artifact but keep some deceleration, for a median ~1,291. I carry forward the runs' ~40 width and their small upper-escape mass for backlog revisions. No market was found by the runs or the harness.
